title: Identification of the Average Treatment Effect under Self-Censored Confounder and Outcome
banked_reason: Stage D0.5 panels found the result mathematically sound, but the general review capped it at subfield (paper score 6.5 below the 7.4 field floor) and found no in-scope salvage.
gap_reasons: Its classification excludes boundary-only compatible fibers, and the higher-rank result is an existence example rather than a characterization of when stationary mixed obstructions occur beyond rank two.

The exact procedure applies to population rational tables and provides neither rank-robust statistical inference nor evidence that the criterion remains usable under sampling noise, which substantially limits the completed package's econometric reach.

The novelty comparison also retains an unresolved duplication risk because the recent closest preprint's cited supplement was unavailable, although that unavailable text alone does not defeat the field-tier floor.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved an exact bilinear coefficient criterion for ATE constancy on nonempty strictly response-positive finite-support fibers, a structural-zero-safe positive-twin converse, and the rank-two/rank-three mixed-obstruction elbow. Both mathematical panels passed with no findings, but the field-tier review capped the package at subfield because boundary-only fibers, a general higher-rank phase characterization, and sampling-robust inference remain outside the result. A future re-raise should reuse the exact decision procedure and rank-three witness while adding one of those genuinely new headline programs.
tldr: Under simultaneous dual self-censoring for a finite confounder and outcome, full-law completeness is stronger than necessary for the causal target. After exact compatibility and strict-feasibility checks, the standardized ATE is constant on an arbitrary-rank positive response-odds fiber exactly when two linear coefficient vectors and one cross-arm mixed matrix vanish. The theorem permits unidentified full laws, certifies every failure with strictly response-positive same-observed-law causal twins even when full-data tables have structural zeros, and proves the sharp rank elbow: when both complete-case ranks are at most two, the linear conditions force the mixed condition, whereas a positive rank-three construction has vanishing linear terms but a nonzero mixed obstruction.
gap: The closest causal result recovers the full law under two completeness conditions, while the closest functional-only result handles one fixed mean integrand and one fully observed shadow variable. Neither inspected line of work classifies a standardized causal contrast whose covariate weights and outcome regressions can vary simultaneously in two treatment arms.
fill: Prove an if-and-only-if coefficient criterion at arbitrary ranks, derive its row-space and rank-frontier consequences, and package it with exact compatibility, strict-feasibility, identified-value, and positive-twin certificates.
